sessionTitle: Powering enterprise-grade AI agents with Windows 365 for Agents

announcements.name: Windows 365 for Agents is generally available
announcements.shortDescription: the platform giving first- and third-party AI agents their own managed Cloud PCs is now GA.
announcements.longDescription: Windows 365 for Agents is announced as generally available, giving AI agents their own Cloud PCs—full Windows environments that can see, interact with apps, and operate the way a real person would. It addresses the problem that agents can reason, plan, and call APIs but get stuck when they need to actually open applications, fill out forms, or navigate legacy systems. The platform bridges the GUI gap, the legacy gap (Win32 applications), and the scale gap by providing enterprise-grade execution environments for agentic workloads at global scale with security and governance.

announcements.name: MCP tool layer for Cloud PCs
announcements.shortDescription: a set of Model Context Protocol tools lets any MCP-speaking agent framework provision, connect to, interact with, and manage the lifecycle of a Cloud PC.
announcements.longDescription: Windows 365 for Agents ships an MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool layer, using the open standard for connecting agents to tools. The set of MCP tools lets an agent provision a Cloud PC, connect to it, interact with it, and manage its lifecycle. If an agent framework speaks MCP, it works with Windows 365 for Agents.

announcements.name: Agent 365 integration
announcements.shortDescription: the MCP tools, observability, and governance for Windows 365-enabled agents surface inside the Agent 365 portal alongside all other enterprise agents.
announcements.longDescription: All of Windows 365 for Agents sits within Agent 365. The MCP tool is managed within the Agent 365 portal, and all of the observability and governance for Windows 365-enabled agents surface the same way they do for any Agent 365-enabled agent. This makes it easy for AI admins to configure Windows 365 for Agents alongside all the other agents in their enterprise tenant.

announcements.name: Intune provisioning policies for agents
announcements.shortDescription: a dedicated experience under Devices > Windows 365 Cloud PCs lets admins create agent-specific pools with billing plans, always-available Cloud PCs, and gallery or custom images.
announcements.longDescription: Pool creation and assignment happen in Intune, where under Devices in Windows 365 Cloud PCs there is a dedicated experience for provisioning Cloud PCs specifically for agents. An admin creates a new provisioning policy by adding a name and description, selecting a billing plan for consumption-based charges, and associating a number of always-available Cloud PCs. Agent instances can be assigned to the policy as employees create them, and both custom and gallery images are supported along with a selectable language.
